summary: Workers with poller autoscaling enabled don't scale down when completely idle, maintaining unnecessary polling connections indefinitely rather than scaling to the minimum configured poller count.
userImpact: Idle workers maintain 5x the necessary polling connections, contributing to polling amplification and wasteful resource usage for unused task queues.
rootCause: Pollers only scale down when receiving autoscaling signals, which never arrive on inactive task queues, preventing scale-down to minimum poller count.
proposedFix: Implement repeated poll timeouts to trigger scale-down, or send a capability flag from server to enable client-side scale-down on empty polls.
keyQuote: When a worker with poller autoscaling enabled goes completely unused (receives 0 tasks), the worker maintains initialConcurrentTaskPollers (default 5) pollers indefinitely
